status:locked: State of the encrypted storage or vault, not a user account.
onboard:step:master:title: Master Password is the administrative password used for backup, restore, and erase; keep this term distinct from Vault Password.
onboard:master:warning: High-severity recovery warning. Losing the Master Password makes restoring backups impossible.
notification:remote-vault-locked: The vault is hosted on another device, and that host device locked it.
statusbar:catalog: Status-bar section for synchronization of the encrypted file catalog, not a product catalog.
statusbar:catalog:idle: File catalog synchronization is complete and current.
statusbar:remote-connection:waiting-host: Remote transport exists, but the mobile host vault is still locked.
statusbar:remote-connection:waiting-phon: The phone vault is open, but the phone must approve this desktop session.
statusbar:android-share-pending: Count of files received through Android Share and waiting to be imported. ${count} is the file count.
statusbar:android-share-pending:detail: Detailed Android Share queue status. ${count} is the waiting file count; ${unknown} is how many have unknown sizes.
navigation:passwords: Navigation label for saved login credentials and secrets; the product surface is called Credentials.
navigation:otp-codes: Navigation label for one-time authentication codes (TOTP/HOTP).
navigation:passkeys: Navigation label for WebAuthn/FIDO passkeys. Use the platform-standard term for the target language.
navigation:storage: Navigation label for mounted volumes, backups, and storage devices; not general app storage settings.
navigation:remote: Navigation label for remote-device connection and vault-host modes.
navigation:extensions: Navigation label for browser-extension gateway pairing, not general app plugins.
wallet:eyebrow: Short overline describing a crypto wallet whose keys live in the encrypted vault and remain under user control.
wallet:activity:incoming: Transaction direction label: assets received by the selected account.
wallet:activity:outgoing: Transaction direction label: assets sent from the selected account.
wallet:activity:from: Field label for the sender address in transaction details.
wallet:activity:to: Field label for the recipient address in transaction details.
wallet:activity:rebroadcast-help: Security-sensitive explanation: resend the exact signed transaction bytes without rebuilding or signing again.
wallet:status:provider-unavailable:title: Network-dependent wallet actions are unavailable because the selected blockchain provider cannot be used.
wallet:preview:amount: Native-asset amount being transferred, before the network fee.
wallet:preview:fee: Estimated blockchain network fee for the transaction.
wallet:preview:total: Total amount deducted from the wallet, including the transfer and applicable network fee.
wallet:preview:seqno: TON wallet-contract sequence number. Keep the protocol term seqno unchanged unless the target language has an established equivalent.
wallet:preview:nonce: Blockchain transaction nonce. Keep the established technical term.
wallet:preview:gas-limit: Ethereum-style transaction gas limit. Keep the established blockchain term gas.
wallet:balance:spendable: Balance currently available to send after protocol restrictions; not necessarily the total balance.
wallet:balance:fetched-at: Timestamp label indicating when the displayed balance was fetched from the network.
wallet:account:derived: Account deterministically derived from an HD wallet recovery phrase.
wallet:account:imported: Account created by importing a network-native private key rather than deriving it from the wallet phrase.
wallet:field:recovery-format: Selector for BIP39 multichain versus native TON recovery-phrase format.
wallet:field:mnemonic: Recovery mnemonic phrase; use the established crypto-wallet term in the target language.
wallet:field:passphrase: Optional BIP39 passphrase, distinct from the recovery words and from app passwords.
wallet:field:master-password: ChromVoid Master Password used to authorize sensitive wallet recovery operations; not the wallet recovery phrase.
wallet:profile:multichain:meta: Compact metadata line. Keep BIP39 literal and preserve the middle-dot separators.
wallet:profile:ton-only:meta: Compact metadata line. Keep TON, Wallet V5R1, and the middle-dot separators literal.
wallet:action:rebroadcast: Action to submit the exact already-signed transaction again; it must not imply creating a new transaction.
wallet:notice:broadcast-unknown: Broadcast means submission to the blockchain network. The user should refresh activity to reconcile the final state.
wallet:accounts:count: Plural noun used after an account count when the generic plural form is required.
wallet:accounts:one: Singular noun used after an account count of one.
wallet:accounts:few: Few-form plural noun for languages with a dedicated few plural category.
wallet:receive:address: Blockchain address currently selected for receiving assets.
wallet:status:discovery:title: Bitcoin address discovery: background scan that restores transaction history across derived addresses.
wallet:send:body: Native asset means the blockchain's own currency, such as BTC, ETH, SOL, or TON. Core is the trusted backend that builds the transaction.
wallet:field:fee-tier: Selector for transaction fee speed/priority, not a subscription tier.
wallet:field:comment:hint: TON transaction comment. The hard limit is 120 UTF-8 bytes, not 120 characters.
wallet:send:available: Spendable native-asset balance available for this transfer.
wallet:send:choose-recipient: Button that opens the recipient selector for a transfer.
wallet:send:max: Control that fills the largest sendable amount after accounting for the network fee.
wallet:send:percent: Phrase displayed after a percentage value; translate it so the full percentage sentence is grammatical.
wallet:send:quote-loading: A fee quote and maximum available amount are being recalculated from current network data.
wallet:send:quote-stale: The previously calculated network-fee quote expired and must be refreshed before Max can be used.
wallet:send:retry-quote: Action to request a fresh transaction-fee quote from the network provider.
wallet:send:own-wallets: Recipient-selector section containing the user's own wallet accounts on the selected network.
wallet:send:address-book: Recipient-selector section containing saved blockchain addresses.
wallet:send:add-contact: Adds a blockchain address to the wallet address book; it does not add a person to the device contacts.
wallet:send:contact-label: Human-readable name assigned to a saved blockchain address.
wallet:send:save-contact: Saves a blockchain address and its label in the wallet address book.
wallet:send:error:max-unavailable: Validation error shown when Max cannot be calculated without a current network-fee quote.
wallet:send:error:comment-too-long: TON comment validation. The limit is measured in UTF-8 bytes, not characters.
notes:quick_view:folder_count: Folder summary. ${count} is the number of Markdown notes in the folder.
file-manager:mobile-count: Compact mobile file count. ${count} is the number of visible files/items.
file-manager:sorted-by: Accessibility/status summary. ${sort} is the selected field and ${direction} is ascending or descending.
file-manager:transfer-details-aria: Screen-reader label. ${label} is the transfer name, ${progress} is a number without the percent sign, and ${bytes} is a formatted byte summary.
upload:speed: Transfer rate. ${speed} is an already formatted byte quantity; /s means per second.
upload:eta:seconds: Compact duration. ${value} is a number of seconds.
upload:eta:minutes: Compact duration. ${value} is a number of minutes.
upload:eta:hours: Compact duration. ${value} is a number of hours.
details:camera-shot: Photo-metadata section containing camera model and capture settings.
details:gps-unavailable-import-risk: Location metadata is absent and may have been stripped by the external import/share pipeline.
media:seek: Media-player control for moving to another playback position.
media:fallback-limited-title: Streaming/compatibility playback cannot be used for this large media file.
media:native-playback-unavailable-title: Platform-native media playback is unavailable; this is distinct from an unsupported media format.
markdown:stale:title: Conflict state: the note changed outside the current editor after it was opened.
markdown:stale:overwrite: Replace the newer external version with the editor's local changes.
markdown:read-only:save-unavailable: Runtime cannot write the note back, although local unsaved editing may continue.
markdown:note-link:unresolved: Internal wiki-style note link whose target cannot be found.
markdown:note-link:ambiguous: Internal wiki-style note link that matches more than one note.
dialogs:rename-file-help: Sentence prefix combined with ${suffix}; do not add final punctuation that breaks the composed sentence.
dialogs:rename-folder-help: Sentence prefix combined with ${suffix}; do not add final punctuation that breaks the composed sentence.
dialogs:path-suffix: Suffix appended directly to a rename-help sentence. It intentionally begins with a space; ${path} is the parent path.
dialogs:android-share-partial-extra: Compact overflow count after a short list. ${count} is the number of additional files.
uploads:file-upload-error: ${suffix} is either empty or the quoted file name; ${message} is the underlying error.
uploads:name-suffix: Optional fragment appended to an upload message. It intentionally begins with a space and contains the quoted file name ${name}.
ssh-agent:title: Approval dialog for a request to sign data with a vault-backed SSH key.
ssh-agent:unknown-source-warning: Security warning appended as a separate paragraph. Preserve the two leading newlines.
ssh-agent:host-line: Optional line appended to the SSH request description. Preserve the leading newline; ${host} is a best-effort inferred host.
ssh-agent:message: Multiline SSH signing request. ${hostLine} and ${warning} are optional preformatted fragments that already contain their own leading newlines.
gateway:settings:title: Gateway through which paired browser extensions request actions from the local desktop vault.
gateway:settings:duration:until-vault-lo: Extension gateway access remains valid until the vault is locked.
gateway:pairing:pin-expires: ${time} is an already formatted remaining duration for the pairing PIN.
gateway:pairing:session-expires: ${time} is an already formatted remaining duration for the whole pairing session.
gateway:policy:require-action: When enabled, every extension-requested vault action needs explicit user approval.
gateway:policy:require-site: When enabled, access is approved per website origin.
gateway:policy:site-allowlist: List of allowed web origins, not a list of extension IDs.
gateway:policy:all-origins: Origin has the web-security meaning of scheme, host, and port.
network-pair:pairing-offer: Serialized pairing offer copied between the mobile host and desktop; not a commercial offer.
network-pair:intro-mobile: ${platform} is the localized/display platform name such as Android or iPhone.
remote:usb-mobile-desc: USB/AOA means the Android Open Accessory transport; keep protocol abbreviations literal.
remote:transport-network-fallback: Network transport used only when the preferred direct transport is unavailable.
remote:usb-mobile-detected-accessory: Android device is already operating in USB accessory/AOA mode.
remote:usb-mobile-detected-candidate: Android device is physically connected but not yet confirmed as a usable paired accessory.
remote:usb-mobile-classification-broken: A local pairing record exists but is inconsistent or unusable.
remote:usb-mobile-classification-ambiguo: Discovery found a device but cannot safely decide which pairing state/action applies.
remote:usb-mobile-recovery-read-only: Continue viewing remote data without writes until another device releases the writer lock.
remote:operating-mode-hint: Switches the app between a vault stored on this device and a vault hosted by a paired device.
remote:connected-peer: The currently connected remote device endpoint; peer is a networking term.
remote:writer-lock-title: Exclusive distributed write lock held by one connected device to prevent concurrent vault writes.
remote:lock-holder: Device/session currently owning the exclusive writer lock.
remote:request-lock: Request ownership of the exclusive writer lock from the current holder.
remote:syncing-with-phase: ${phase} is a short runtime-provided synchronization phase appended to the sentence.
settings:vault-password-title: Vault Password encrypts the active local vault for daily access; it is distinct from Master Password.
settings:vault-password-description: Changing the Vault Password re-encrypts the active local vault. Existing backups still use the old password.
settings:vault-password-progress-summary: Migration progress. ${done} and ${total} are chunk counts; chunk is a storage-data unit.
settings:autofill-incompatible: Credential Provider/Autofill needs background vault access, so it conflicts with locking the vault whenever the app enters the background.
settings:provider-title: Operating-system credential provider and password AutoFill integration on Android, iOS, and macOS.
settings:provider-enable-macos: Action used while the macOS Credential Provider is known to be disabled; macOS may show a system confirmation prompt.
settings:provider-manage-macos: Action used when the macOS provider is enabled or its status is unknown; it opens the system AutoFill settings.
settings:provider-step-2-macos: The Credential Provider cannot unlock the encrypted vault itself; the main ChromVoid app must already have an unlocked vault.
passkeys:explainer-description: Passkey means a phishing-resistant WebAuthn/FIDO credential backed by a public/private key pair.
passkeys:storage-vault: Badge indicating the passkey is portable because it is stored in the ChromVoid vault.
passkeys:sign-count: WebAuthn signature counter associated with the credential; ${value} is the numeric counter.
passkeys:delete-note: Relying party means the website or service that registered the passkey.
settings:license-seats-title: Seats are device/user activations allowed by one Pro license.
settings:license-release-seat: Deactivate this device's use of one license seat so it can be used elsewhere.
welcome:proof-remote-pair: Pairing uses an offer plus PIN, but only the mobile host can perform the final local vault unlock.
welcome:remote-flow-read-write: Compact connection-capability value meaning both read and write access.
welcome:remote-flow-vault-host-unlock: Compact technical status: the vault must be unlocked locally on the host device.
welcome:waiting-for-peer: Title. ${peer} is the display name/type of the remote peer being awaited.
welcome:unlock-proof-prefix: First sentence fragment in the unlock privacy proof. It intentionally ends with a space and is followed by unlock-proof-device.
welcome:unlock-proof-device: Emphasized middle fragment completing 'Unlock happens …'. It must combine grammatically with unlock-proof-prefix.
welcome:unlock-proof-secrets: Second sentence prefix in the unlock privacy proof. It intentionally ends with a space and is followed by unlock-proof-sealed.
welcome:unlock-proof-sealed: Emphasized middle fragment completing 'Secrets stay …'. It must combine grammatically with its prefix and suffix.
welcome:unlock-proof-suffix: Final fragment in the unlock privacy proof. It intentionally begins with a space and follows unlock-proof-sealed.
welcome:catalog-repair-message-with-seq: Recovery operation for the encrypted catalog log. ${safeSeq} is the last safe sequence, ${seq} is the failing sequence, and ${path} is the affected path.
welcome:remove-paired-host-message: Confirmation sentence. ${label} is the paired device name and ${target} is a localized device-kind noun such as iPhone host or network peer.
remote-storage:security-text: Security warning: a mounted volume exposes a decrypted view to the operating system and other applications.
remote-storage:macfuse-optional-text: macOS-only optional acceleration notice. macFUSE is third-party software that ChromVoid neither bundles nor installs; WebDAV is the no-install fallback.
remote-storage:what-exported-text: Backup contains all vaults and files in encrypted form; restoring it requires the Master Password.
remote-storage:remember-password: Heading telling the user not to lose the Master Password; it is not a checkbox that stores the password in the app.
remote-storage:progress-block: Backup/export progress. ${current} and ${total} count encrypted data blocks.
guidance:pro.remote.blocked:body: Entitlement is the Pro-license permission state; rollout is a server/build feature-release policy.
guidance:remote-storage.mount-warning:bo: Mounted vault data is decrypted for OS-level access until the vault is locked/unmounted again.
otp-import:local-description: Security boundary: an inbound otpauth seed is never forwarded to a remote Core; import requires the local vault on this Mac.
otp-import:website-warning: Domain honesty: issuer/account metadata is not treated as a website. Without a user-entered valid website, the OTP is saved but has no contextual system AutoFill identity.
otp-import:duplicate-description: This copy must preserve the explicit-choice guarantee: matching OTP labels are never silently overwritten.
settings:provider-macos-multi-provider-n: Apple Passwords and ChromVoid can remain enabled at the same time. AutoFill source selection and verification-code setup-app selection are separate macOS controls.
settings:provider-otp-unverified: Use when public/runtime checks cannot prove all readiness conditions. Never translate this state as ready or enabled.
